title: Subjects and opinions
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: School: what school is like (3.1)
source: Seeded from arabic/y10 lesson 48 (Pupil PDF worksheet: subjects and opinions)
intro: Lesson 48: School subjects and opinions. To understand how to name school subjects and give opinions with reasons

questions.q: Give an opinion with a reason about Arabic.
questions.a: For example: أُحِبُّ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ لِأَنَّهَا لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ
questions.model: Teacher: verb of opinion + subject (accusative after أُحِبُّ) + لِأَنَّهَا + reason: أُحِبُّ اللُّغَةَ العَرَبِيَّةَ لِأَنَّهَا لُغَةُ القُرْآنِ.

questions.q: Write a 1AA0 Paper 4-style answer (our own, about 90 words) in the portal response box: your subjects, your favourite and least favourite with reasons, and which subject you will study next year. Group A: also add one sentence of i'rab for an opinion sentence. Start: أَدْرُسُ ... مَوَادَّ ...
questions.a: About 90 words, accurate agreement, a range of opinions and reasons, a future time frame with سَـ
questions.model: Teacher writes the opening: أَدْرُسُ تِسْعَ مَوَادَّ، وَمَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ هِيَ العُلُومُ.

questions.q: Group B: answer aloud: مَا رَأْيُكَ فِي الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ؟ with two reasons.
Back to our ponder: which subject helps most in each life?
questions.a: Pupils' own; beneficial knowledge with good intention helps in both
